meta.name: epic-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive EPICs from FSDs, TDDs, or high-level requirements. Use when the user needs to plan a large feature, break down a project into deliverables, or create high-level roadmap items. Triggers on requests like "create epics", "break down this project", "generate high-level tasks", or "plan the feature delivery".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解需求成可交付的大计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把模糊需求变成清晰计划
copy.tagline_en: Turn requirements into deliverable feature plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to structure vague ideas into a clear feature roadmap

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的功能或技术文档拆解成一组带编号的「EPIC」（大功能卡片）。它会先确认产品代号、范围等信息，再按逻辑分组输出每个 EPIC 的标题、依赖关系和验收标准，并确保覆盖所有需求。
howto.when: 当你要规划大功能、拆分项目或创建高层路线图，或说出“create epics”“break down this project”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份 FSD 拆成 EPIC。
say.note: Claude 会读取文档并生成 EPIC 初稿。

say.text: 根据 TDD 生成一组带依赖关系的 EPIC。
say.note: 会列出依赖和可追溯性。

say.text: 我要规划产品发布，先创建高层路线图的 EPIC。
say.note: 会先访谈产品代码和范围等信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude transforms your FSD/TDD or high-level requirements into a set of numbered EPIC files. It gathers product code and scope first, then groups work into EPICs with dependencies, acceptance criteria, and traceability back to source requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to plan a large feature, break down a project, or create roadmap items, or when you say things like 'create epics' or 'break down this project'.

say_en.text: Break down this FSD into EPICs.
say_en.note: Claude reads the doc and drafts EPICs.

say_en.text: Generate EPICs from this TDD with dependencies.
Plan the feature delivery - create high-level EPICs.
say_en.note: Will interview for product code and scope first.
